items.title: September Natural Gas Bidweek Kicks Off as Summer Cooling Demand Eases
items.summary: Baseload natural gas prices were mostly lower for September delivery on the first day of bidweek trading, with fading summer cooling demand pressuring hubs even as lingering heat risks offered support for some holdouts.

items.title: US Natural Gas Market Shrugs Off Supportive Forecasts, Iran War Chaos
items.summary: Despite stout cooling demand expected to persist well into September, natural gas futures struggled to find their footing on Tuesday amid plentiful supply, sluggish LNG feedgas and a looming seasonal dropoff in consumption.

items.title: Permian Pipeline Expansion Shifts Natural Gas Pressure Toward Agua Dulce
items.summary: Kinder Morgan’s (KMI) 570 MMcf/d Gulf Coast Express (GCX) expansion has uncorked Permian Basin congestion, but it could be shifting the natural gas supply glut down to Agua Dulce.

items.title: Louisiana LNG Advancing Despite Potential Supply Chain Impacts Caused by Iran War
items.summary: Woodside Energy said Tuesday that the first liquefaction train at its Louisiana LNG project is 35% complete and the facility remains on track to produce the super-chilled fuel in 2029 from its first phase.

items.title: Natural Gas Speculators Add Shorts Ahead of October Shift
items.summary: Natural gas speculators increased their net-short position as expectations for abundant supply persisted heading into the fall shoulder season, even as some fundamentals point to a tighter balance in the weeks ahead.

items.title: Shoulder Season Chill Hits Natural Gas Futures Despite Near-Term Hotter Forecast

items.title: Will Technical Floor Hold for September Natural Gas Futures?
items.summary: Technical barriers contributed to rangebound natural gas futures early this week, though selling Tuesday morning brought support thresholds into focus.

items.title: US LNG Follows Storage, Not Heat, as Cargoes Swing to Europe
items.summary: Record-low Atlantic shipping rates and a closed arbitrage to Asia are pushing US cargoes toward a European market as storage concerns outweigh weather forecasts.

items.title: Southwest Natural Gas Prices Surge on Searing Heat as East Softens
items.summary: Physical natural gas pricing on Tuesday was split roughly along the Continental Divide, with gains in the Rocky Mountains and California offsetting losses in the eastern two-thirds of the Lower 48.

items.title: Satellite Images Show Seven Tankers Loading Iraqi Crude at Once
items.summary: Seven crude carriers were moored at Iraq’s Persian Gulf export facilities on August 24—a sharp increase from recent weeks. The carriers had a combined carrying capacity of roughly 13 million barrels, according to satellite imagery analyzed by Bloombe
